name: Generative Agents (Park et al.)
ontology_notes: Per-agent AssociativeMemory of ConceptNode with type thought|event|chat, SPO triple, description, embedding, poignancy, keywords, filling (evidence ids), created, expiration, last_accessed, depth. Separate streams seq_event, seq_thought, seq_chat. This is an agent's own memory of a simulated town, not a companion-user relationship store.

ontology.evidence: ConceptNode in reverie/backend_server/persona/memory_structures/associative_memory.py. Types event, thought, chat. Fields subject, predicate, object, description, poignancy, keywords, filling, created, expiration. Plans and reflections are written back as thoughts.
ontology.label: measured

write_policy.evidence: Perceive module writes observations with LLM poignancy. Reflection writes evidence-linked thoughts when accumulated importance crosses a threshold (paper architecture; reflect.py). add_event, add_thought, add_chat on AssociativeMemory. No user pin. No refusal of hypotheticals.
write_policy.label: measured

read_policy.evidence: new_retrieve in retrieve.py scores recency * 0.5 + relevance * 3 + importance * 2 (gw=[0.5, 3, 2]), top n_count=30, then sets last_accessed. Keyword retrieve_relevant_events/thoughts also exist. Retrieved nodes go into planning and dialogue prompts.
read_policy.label: measured

supersession.evidence: New nodes are prepended. No overwrite of an old fact. Reflections add higher-depth thoughts citing filling evidence ids. Contradictions accumulate.
supersession.label: measured

temporal.evidence: created, expiration, last_accessed on ConceptNode. Recency decay persona.scratch.recency_decay ** i in extract_recency. Paper retrieval combines recency, relevance, importance. Agents plan a day then replan.
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: Each persona has its own memory stream. Memories of other agents are events/chats inside that stream, not a separate relationship object. No user vs character vs lore split because there is no companion user.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: Retrieval is score-max. No trauma or spoiler controls in retrieve.py.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: Anything perceived is stored as natural language and can be retrieved into the next plan. No trust tags.
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: expiration field exists on ConceptNode. Recency decay downranks old unused nodes. Retrieval refreshes last_accessed. Idle events are filtered from retrieve. No user forget-that.
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: Per observation an embedding plus a poignancy LLM call. Retrieval embeds each focal point. Reflection is extra LLM calls when the importance accumulator fires. Paper notes the architecture is expensive. Released code uses OpenAI ChatGPT.
cost_shape.label: inferred

local.evidence: Apache-2.0 LICENSE. Full simulation code is public. Runtime in the paper is ChatGPT. Intimate 1:1 chat is not the product. You can run the sim if you supply an LLM.
local.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: Foundational memory stream plus reflection, not a companion product. Each NPC remembers a town. There is no user-companion relationship type, no silence, no forget-that. Eval is believable sandbox behavior, not months of 1:1 roleplay.

published_eval.name: Park et al. 2023 believability, information diffusion, and relationship interviews in The Ville
published_eval.claimed_score: Agents with the full memory-reflection-planning architecture judged more believable than ablations (paper §5). Exact numeric tables live in the PDF, not restated here.
published_eval.what_it_actually_scores: Whether simulated town agents produce coherent daily plans, spread information, and form relationships that look human to interviewers. Not companion fact QA, social silence, or persona hijack.

open_unknowns: Whether expiration is actually enforced at retrieve time or only stored.
Precise interview scores from the paper figures, unread as numbers in this pass.
